title: 第2章 败剑有声
lines: 第一声剑鸣之后，整座废剑冢都醒了。
沈照夜按着照夜剑柄，耳边忽然炸开无数声音。
断裂声，入肉声，撞甲声，风雪里剑锋拖过城砖的刺响。
成百上千道声音一起钻进脑子，像有人把整座战场塞进他的头骨。
他额头撞在石壁上，眼前黑了一瞬。
有人握着一柄残缺军剑，右手虎口裂开，左臂已经没了。那人还在往前冲，面前是三名黑甲剑修。
半寸之后，剑断，人倒，雪地里溅出一线血。
那声音贴着沈照夜耳边响起。
眼前没有雪，也没有关门。
那股死前的冷意还压在胸口。他想松开照夜，右臂却像被碎铁钉住，一动，骨头里就传来刮擦般的疼。
他看向脚边那柄断裂军剑。
剑身只剩半截，剑脊上刻着一个模糊的“关”字。
刚才那场雪，就是从这柄剑里来的。
指尖刚挨上剑柄，那句话又响起来。
天色发灰，石门被人推开，潮冷晨光挤进来。
裴安站在门口，身后跟着两个杂役弟子，一个提铁钩，一个拿锁链。
content_en:
After the first sword cry, the entire Abandoned Sword Tomb woke up.
Shen Zhaoye pressed the hilt of Zhaoye's sword, and countless sounds suddenly exploded in his ears.
The sound of breaking, the sound of flesh being penetrated, the sound of armor hitting, and the sound of the sword dragging across city bricks in the wind and snow.
Hundreds of voices entered his mind together, as if someone had crammed the entire battlefield into his skull.
His forehead hit the stone wall, and his vision went dark for a moment.
The next moment, he saw a patch of snow.
Snow does not fall on Qingyue Sword Academy.
It landed in front of a closed door.
Someone was holding a mutilated sword, the right hand's jaw was split open, and his left arm was gone. The man was still rushing forward, and in front of him were three black-armored sword cultivators.
The first sword opened.
Hold the second sword.
The third sword should have been tilted back to the wrist.
But that hand was half an inch slower.
Half an inch later, the sword broke, the man fell, and a line of blood spattered on the snow.
"The third position, the wrist return is too slow."
The voice sounded close to Shen Zhaoye's ears.
Low, dumb, as if it were ground out of rust.
Shen Zhaoye opened his eyes suddenly.
He is still at the Abandoned Sword Tomb.
There was no snow in front of me, and there was no door closed.
Just black soil, broken swords, and rainy nights.
The coldness of death was still pressing in his chest. He wanted to let go of Teruya, but his right arm felt like it was nailed by broken iron. Whenever he moved, there was a scratching pain in his bones.
Shen Zhaoye gritted his teeth and let go.
Jian Ming lowered his voice.
He looked at the broken sword at his feet.
Only half of the sword body is left, and a vague word "Guan" is engraved on the spine.
The snow just now came from this sword.
Shen Zhaoye reached out to touch it.
As soon as his fingertips touched the hilt of the sword, those words rang out again.
"The third position, the wrist return is too slow."
He immediately withdrew his hand.
It's not skin pain.
It's the resentment of the sword drilling into the cracks in the bones.
This thing works.
It will also kill you.
There were footsteps outside the stone door.
The sky turned gray, the stone door was pushed open, and the cold morning light squeezed in.
Pei An stood at the door, followed by two handyman disciples, one holding an iron hook and the other holding a chain.
title_en: Chapter 2 The defeated sword has a sound
